shelters.name: ASPCA
shelters.description: American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals headquartered in NYC. Provides adoption and medical services to the public.

shelters.name: Animal Care Centers of NYC
shelters.description: NYC's largest animal shelter maintaining database of pets for adoption and resources for pet owners.

shelters.name: Humane Society of New York
shelters.description: Founded 1904, nonprofit veterinary hospital and no-kill shelter. Makes high-quality, affordable veterinary care accessible. Fights for stronger animal welfare legislation.

shelters.name: Best Friends Animal Society NYC
shelters.description: Leading the no-kill movement with lifesaving adoption and spay/neuter programs for dogs and cats across all five boroughs and tri-state area.

shelters.name: North Shore Animal League America
shelters.description: World's largest no-kill animal rescue and adoption organization. Among NY's largest animal welfare nonprofits.

shelters.name: Mayor's Alliance for NYC's Animals
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded 2003. Source of information for pet owners seeking services and resources to care for their pets in NYC.

shelters.name: Animal Haven
shelters.description: No-kill animal shelter in Manhattan finding homes for abandoned cats and dogs in New York.

shelters.name: Bideawee
shelters.description: One of America's oldest animal welfare organizations. Provides adoption, veterinary services, and pet bereavement support.

shelters.name: Central New York SPCA
shelters.description: Speaks for those who cannot speak for themselves. Running capital campaign for growing needs. Received $172,490 grant for roof replacement.

shelters.name: Mohawk Hudson Humane Society
shelters.description: Received $500,000 for new veterinary suite. Serves Albany and Capital Region.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Rochester and Monroe County
shelters.description: Among NY's largest humane societies. Lollypop Farm provides animal welfare services to Rochester and Monroe County.

shelters.name: Southampton Animal Shelter Foundation
shelters.description: Received $500,000 for new Behavior Training Center allowing year-round rehabilitation work with dogs.

shelters.name: Sean Casey Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Brooklyn-based nonprofit providing shelter, medical care, and adoption services for cats, dogs, and small animals.

shelters.name: Finger Lakes SPCA of CNY
shelters.description: Offers pet adoption, low-cost spay/neuter services, and community help to keep animals safe and loved.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Walden
shelters.description: No-kill, nonprofit safe haven for stray and abandoned cats and dogs. Serves Montgomery, Walden, Maybrook, Crawford, and surrounding communities.

notes: Comprehensive collection of New York animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. ASPCA and North Shore Animal League America are among the nation's largest. Humane Society of New York founded 1904. Mayor's Alliance founded 2003. Coverage spans NYC (all five boroughs), Long Island, Albany, Syracuse, Rochester, and Hudson Valley.
